caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, commonly known as a highboy, in various shades of brown. The highboy has two main sections: an upper segment with five drawers and a lower segment with three larger drawers. The uppermost section includes a central shell-carved motif above the top drawer, and is flanked by two small finials on either side and a larger central finial, all of which have a dark brown hue. Each drawer is adorned with two brass-colored handles in a decorative style. The lower section of the highboy features cabriole legs and has a scalloped apron, with a central shell-carved motif matching the design in the upper section. The chest is positioned against a plain off-white background, with no other objects or decorations present in the image. The grain and texture of the wood are visible throughout the piece.
title: Highboy
